## Future checkpoint format

Append implementation entries using the existing Architect checkpoint grammar: an H3 containing an ISO timestamp, an em dash, `slice: <parser-projected slice id>`, another em dash and `status: <actual outcome>`. Obtain the exact slice ID from plan projection. Record commands/results, evidence and code/graph revisions, reviewer, known limits, rollback and `- Resume note:`. Do not copy a success status until its acceptance evidence exists. Audit-only activity must not be recorded as an implementation checkpoint.
